facts.fact: Decree 2013-158 of 12 April 2013 approved the sector policy document for telecommunications and ICT, as stated by the Ministry's chief of staff in 2020.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC 2013-2020

facts.fact: The decree-approved telecommunications and ICT sector policy covers 2013-2020, and the Ministry says it is at the end of that period.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC 2013-2020

facts.fact: Work on a successor digital policy, 'Niger Numérique 2021-2030', was launched in Niamey on 19 July 2020 (article of 20 July says 'yesterday'), to revise the sector policy; a national technical committee is to draft it and the final text is to be submitted to Government for adoption.
The digital policy being drafted is for the period 2021-2030.
The Ministry set up a national technical committee charged with drafting the digital policy, with a steering committee endorsing the study's adjustments; no funding source is stated.
The article gives no funding source for the drafting study or the 2013-2020 policy.
The study is to produce a review of the implementation of the sector policy's main axes, setting out achievements and shortfalls, without stated indicators or figures against targets.
facts.system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC 2013-2020
